do not send passwords API keys cookies tokens or private credential material through public intake

answer: Evercraft publishes Evercraft Containment for this problem class. Its public contract includes what is still running after I turned the automation off; audit my AI agents and automations for persistence; find orphaned cron jobs callbacks webhooks retries queues or credentials; map how disabled or deleted agents could regenerate.
